summary: Audit log export missing event types (customer evidence export incomplete)
description:
Issue summary:
Northbridge Bank reports that audit log exports (CSV/JSON evidence package) are missing certain event types that are visible in the Console audit log viewer / internal query results. This is blocking their security review because the exported evidence does not show expected access/admin actions.

Customer impact:
- Compliance evidence export appears incomplete (missing key admin/RBAC-related actions), raising concerns about audit log coverage.
- Procurement/security review is time-sensitive; they requested an updated export for the last 30 days.

Environment:
- Product: Redwood Dedicated
- Region: us-east
- Export method: Audit Log Exporter (report template-based export)
- Export formats: CSV + JSON bundle

Reported missing event types (examples from customer):
- rbac.role_assignment.created
- rbac.role_assignment.updated
- api_key.created
- api_key.revoked
(They also expected to see console.login events, but it is unclear if those are in-scope for the current audit log taxonomy.)

Steps to reproduce (internal):
1) In audit-log-exporter, run the "Customer Evidence - Admin Actions" template for tenant NBK-*** over 2025-01-20 to 2025-02-19.
2) Compare output event_type distribution vs. control-plane query against audit_logs for same tenant/time window.
3) Observe exporter output includes core events (e.g., model.deploy, org.user.invited) but not RBAC/api_key event types.

Notes / initial hypothesis:
Exporter report templates appear to apply an event type allowlist. The allowlist likely lags newly introduced event types or does not include RBAC/api_key categories. The Console viewer may be querying a broader set (or using a different service path).

Requested outcome:
- Confirm whether the missing event types are expected (taxonomy / product scope) vs. exporter bug.
- If bug: patch exporter and re-issue a complete evidence export for the requested time window.

Attachments (from customer via Support email):
- "northbridge_audit_export_2025-02-19.csv" (shows ~14 event types total; none from RBAC/api_key)
- Screenshot from their review checklist indicating required categories: admin access changes, credential lifecycle, and policy changes.

Support owner notes:
This is tied to SUP-3842 (enterprise customer requests retention controls + report pack). Customer explicitly asked for "audit-log coverage summary" and a time-windowed export suitable for SOC2 evidence. We should align with the standard templates in Confluence and avoid ad-hoc queries unless approved by Security/GRC.
comments: 2025-02-19 10:12 PT — Rachel Kim (CS): Customer escalated during security review call. They can see RBAC/API key changes in Console, but the exported evidence package does not include those events. Requested: last 30 days, all admin/security-relevant actions, delivered as CSV + JSON. Looping in Kevin Osei for exporter investigation.

2025-02-19 11:03 PT — Kevin Osei (Eng): Acknowledged. I pulled the export template used by the exporter. It’s applying a hardcoded event_type IN (...) filter. RBAC + api_key events are not in the list. Next: confirm taxonomy ownership + whether those events should be included in the "Customer Evidence - Admin Actions" template. If yes, patch template/filtering and ship.

2025-02-19 11:24 PT — Olga Petrov (GRC): From an evidence perspective, RBAC role assignment and API key lifecycle events must be in the baseline pack. If those are emitted in audit logs, exports should include them. Console login events are nice-to-have but we should be careful about scope/definition; prioritize RBAC + credential lifecycle.

2025-02-19 12:05 PT — Kevin Osei (Eng): Confirmed via control-plane query: events exist for NBK-*** in the requested window (rbac.role_assignment.updated, api_key.revoked). Exporter template filter is the reason they’re missing. Root cause: exporter’s template allowlist wasn’t updated when new event types were added; also the exporter UI/CLI doesn’t clearly indicate it’s filtering by allowlist vs "all events".

2025-02-19 12:22 PT — Rachel Kim (CS): Replying to customer: we found a filtering issue in the export tool. We’ll provide a corrected export and follow up with a permanent fix. Requested confirmation: time window 2025-01-20 through 2025-02-19 UTC, and include RBAC + credential lifecycle categories.

2025-02-20 09:18 PT — Kevin Osei (Eng): Fix is being rolled into audit-log-exporter improvements to support time-windowed exports and explicit filters (PR-612). As part of that, we’re updating the default templates and adding an "All event types" mode that does not apply the stale allowlist unless explicitly requested.

2025-02-20 14:41 PT — Kevin Osei (Eng): Workaround for today: I ran a direct export using an internal query path (no allowlist) and validated event_type distribution includes RBAC + api_key events. Shared package with Rachel for customer delivery (internal link in ticket: /secure/attachments/SUP-3917/northbridge_audit_export_fixed_2025-02-20.zip).

2025-02-21 10:07 PT — Rachel Kim (CS): Customer confirmed receipt and that RBAC + API key events are now present. They asked for a brief written explanation of why the initial export was incomplete and what changed. I’ll send: “template filter allowlist was outdated; exporter fix in progress; we validated completeness against source audit log store.”

2025-02-24 16:33 PT — Kevin Osei (Eng): PR-612 merged. Includes: (1) time-windowed exports, (2) explicit event-type filters, (3) template refresh to include RBAC + api_key categories, and (4) clearer metadata in the export manifest indicating applied filters. Deployment scheduled for next exporter release train.

2025-02-26 09:55 PT — Kevin Osei (Eng): Deployed audit-log-exporter release containing PR-612 to prod. Re-ran the standard "Customer Evidence - Admin Actions" template for NBK-*** and confirmed RBAC + api_key events are included. Marking Resolved.

2025-02-26 10:02 PT — Rachel Kim (CS): Closing loop with customer: exporter fix deployed; future exports should include the missing categories. Also pointed them to the updated evidence template naming and asked them to re-run from their side if needed. Moving ticket to Resolved.
resolution: Root cause was an outdated event type allowlist in audit-log-exporter report templates, which filtered out RBAC role assignment and API key lifecycle events. Implemented exporter fix to support explicit filters and updated templates; deployed to production. Provided corrected export package to customer as immediate workaround prior to deployment.
next_steps: 1) Update internal Security FAQ / evidence guidance to note that exports include a manifest listing applied filters and event_type coverage. 2) Add a lightweight regression check in exporter CI to detect newly introduced audit event types not covered by baseline templates. 3) Follow up with GRC on whether console.login should be included in baseline pack or handled as separate auth telemetry.
